en: • Hi-ν GUNDAM is available in the MG lineup in Ver.Ka. Under the supervision of mechanic designer Hajime Katoki, new proportions have been realized.
• While utilizing the know-how cultivated in MG ν GUNDAM Ver.Ka, the armor, differences in armament, and characteristic funnels are reproduced.
• Equipped with a concealed weapon on the forearm.
• Thrusters can be moved for each part.
• Various weapons are included in abundance. Weapons mountable.
• Comes with a dedicated stand. Molded part ×26, slide mark ×1, foil seal ×1, assembly instruction ×1
